annotations.title: CI cost fix bundle (one PR, several fixes)

description: Read one CI cost fix bundle (one draft PR for several fixes in one repo, from apply_ci_cost_fix_rollout) by its bundleId: { bundle: { id, projectId, repo, status (queued | running | pr_opened | nothing_opened | failed), prUrl, prNumber, items (each fix: workflowPath, kind, status, summary, error, prUrl, baseline, measured, saving), measuredUsdPerMonth (after the merge: the saving measured per workflow, each workflow once) } }. After the merge it reads GitHub once and stores the minutes per day since. Read-only on GitHub.
name: get_ci_cost_fix_bundle
title: CI cost fix bundle (one PR, several fixes)
